summary: The official Sudan National Information Center documents a national spatial portal advertising WMS/WFS, but the linked geoportal failed bounded DNS resolution. No public parcel schema, CRS, safe native ID, or polygon geometry was verified for Ad-Damazin.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery was performed and recorded in city-5110-ad-damazin.json. The official NIC project page was inspected. A bounded anonymous GET to the linked geoportal timed out during DNS resolution; no credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: No first-party local registry/cadastre custodian for Ad-Damazin was established. The NIC page is national institutional evidence only. A secondary Arabic source cites a Damazin Survey Office for a locality map, but that does not establish a public cadastral service or local registry integration.
